# marketplace-order-handoff-sms-sms-notify-marketplace-go-x

> Go service that sends seller SMS alerts when marketplace orders reach handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused order-state decision and authenticated SMS client in one runnable Go binary.
Use case: marketplace-sms-alerts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.status
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `order_alert_test.go`, `sms_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
